About

Welcome to ORUNTO, OWU, ABEOKUTA, and Yorubaland's premier online platform!

This website embodies the spirit of Owu people, showcasing their rich heritage, customs, traditions, and cultures to the world. With a focus on southwest Nigeria, our platform weaves a narrative of people, places, and events that shape our collective identity to preservation.

  • Explore our web of pages, carefully crafted to readers:
  • Engage and enlighten
    Share research outcomes and stories
  • Preserve and promote our cultural legacy
    Serve as document and reference

    Our mission is to serve humanity and future generations, fostering a community that interacts, learns, and grows together. United, we strive for common goals that benefit all.

Orunto Baalufe Owu Kingdom Abeokuta will serve as a unifying hub, bringing together diverse settlements and townships to:

  • Celebrate shared history and heritage
  • Strengthen relationships and foster cooperation
  • Promote mutual understanding and benefits

By converging around our common roots, we aim to create a harmonious and thriving virtual and physical community that values collaboration, collective growth, and prosperity.

Our scope of coverage:

1 ORUNTO

This is an official platform of ORUNTO, the personality of the holder and his activities. The Orunto Descendants, the title, our village, related information, etc. The institution of the legacies and heritage as Iwarefa Owu and kingmaker of the kingdom Abeokuta.

2 OWU

It’s about the ancient history of Owu people, contemporary issues, write-ups, other Owu Narratives, Villages, Compounds, Orisas, Obas, etc. Featuring Owu Kingdom Abeokuta, particularly its settlements, history, and so on.

3 ABEOKUTA

Abeokuta headquartered the Egbas who are predominantly on Egbaland (six local governments) and all over the world. It’s with verifiable information that we are going to be promoting documents, clips, literatures and references about the greatest of Egbaland. This page is about Egbaland in general, Sections, Townships, activities, etc

  1. SIXTHSENSE

The SixthSense Initiative is a registered nonprofit organisation hugely promoting children reading culture and human capacity development. The SixthSense Initiative concepts are creative programmes, activities, etc.

5 CULTURES

The Owu cultural heritage that is worthy of preservation and promotion.

We are addressing issues of who we are, what we were used to be and talking about Yoruba people, attires, food, houses, languages. We are going to make “Omoluabi a running agenda of discourse

Our Scope Continues

6 ENTERTAINMENTS

Showcasing traditional music artistes, awards winners, events and social activities. Featuring stories of indigenous entertainment, music, ceremonies, and so on.

7 PERSONALITIES

History of the people of Owu Kingdom Abeokuta stock; dead heroes, living legends, prospecting young ones, indigenes, and various achievers.

8 PUBLICATIONS

Featuring Sixth Sense Series Publications activities, reviews, Literatures, Owu write-ups, historical pieces, etc

9 OWU PEOPLE

This is about Owu communities spread all over the world; Cities, Settlements, history, celebrations, Narratives, Personalities, Festivals, and so on.

10 NEWS & ARCHIVES

Basically, news activities and developments around South West Nigeria and the international environment.

As the Founder and Coordinator of The SixthSense Initiative and Sixth Sense Series Publications, I pledge to steer this platform with utmost responsibility, transparency, and dedication.

Join me on this journey to celebrate our heritage and forge a brighter future!

Abiodun Lasile DL MnbR
Orunto Baalufe Owu Kingdom Abeokuta
Founder/Coordinator, The SixthSense Initiative and Sixth Sense Series Publications

Contact:

Agbole Orunto, Oke Ago-Owu, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria. 
D5, OGD Worker’s Estate, Laderin, Abeokuta, Ogun State.
+234 803 717 1759, +234 802 719 1291
